parsed.english: For every k ≥ 2, R(k) ≥ ((1/(6e^38)) · k^(1/3) / log k)^k, where R(k) is the least n such that every k-colouring of the edges of K_n has a monochromatic triangle. Also, for every real bound b there is N such that R(k)^(1/k) ≥ b for all k ≥ N, so R(k)^(1/k) tends to infinity.
